label: has policy towards
definition: Government or institution X has an explicitly identified policy directed toward entity Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit X policy-toward Y; an identified institutional policy concerning Y; historical policy target. Excludes: trade, travel, armed conflict, or ordinary relations without a policy assertion; an individual statement without institutional policy attribution; generic support or opposition alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear policy owner or target; a proposed policy without establishment; a topic or population substituted for an unresolved entity. This identifies the policy target only; it does not assert a favorable stance, diplomatic relations, or policy effectiveness.

facts.reason: Stephen Gillers → New York University Law School: Professor and legal-specialist roles at a law school do not establish a government policy toward that school.
